pudding-flavors-other-than-chocolate-rea.title: Sugar‑Free Ready‑to‑Eat Pudding, Flavors Other Than Chocolate

content.title: About
content.content: Pudding is a ready‑to‑eat dessert made from milk and thickeners, available in several sugar‑free flavors. It is gluten‑free, suitable for vegetarians, and has a low glycemic index.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Sugar‑free pudding is often sweetened with stevia or erythritol, providing sweetness without raising blood glucose.
Without added sugar, the product has a longer shelf life because sugar‑driven fermentation is minimized.
Flavor options such as vanilla, caramel, berry, and mango allow variety without using chocolate.

items.title: Low sugar content
items.content: The absence of added sugar helps control blood glucose levels and is suitable for weight‑management diets.

items.title: Rich source of calcium
items.content: The milk base supplies a significant amount of calcium essential for bone health.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Pudding provides riboflavin (B2) and vitamin B12, supporting energy metabolism.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: Its smooth texture makes it convenient for children and older adults.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: Because the product is milk‑based, people with lactose intolerance should choose a lactose‑free version.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Some individuals may react to casein or whey proteins.

items.title: Artificial sweeteners
items.content: Certain sweeteners can cause gastrointestinal discomfort when consumed in large amounts.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The pudding is ready to eat straight from the package. It can be enjoyed as a standalone dessert, blended into smoothies, used as a filling for pancakes, or paired with berries and nuts.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the pudding in the refrigerator at 2 °C–6 °C. After opening, consume within 3–5 days. Do not freeze, as the texture may change.
